第 3 杯（右侧）明显最浅、最透
——明亮的樱桃红，光线能透过杯身。内比奥罗即使年轻也以颜色浅淡著称，所以 2023 年内比奥罗最符合。1999 年的赤霞珠在杯沿通常会更多呈现砖红、橙色或黄褐色，而这一杯看起来更接近鲜亮的宝石红。
第 1 杯（左侧）颜色最深、最不透明，
杯心几乎呈紫黑色。这就是 2019 年赤霞珠——经过七年，赤霞珠仍保有浓郁色泽和 primary fruit。
第 2 杯（中间）介于两者之间：
仍然深色，但比第 1 杯稍透一些，也更偏沉闷的宝石红。一瓶 25 年以上的赤霞珠，假设储存得当，应该已经褪去一些紫色和不透明度，但尚未完全转为砖红，所以归在这里。

blocks.text: 我们还通过两层监控来保障训练和评估的安全。第一层是同步监控：监控器在工具调用执行前先做检查。每个任务都会声明自己授权哪些操作，确定性规则会对照任务策略和规避模式检查这些调用，遇到不确定的情况就升级交给 LLM 裁判处理。第二层是异步监控：LLM 裁判会审查训练和评估中已完成的 rollout，检查是否存在不当行为以及越过安全边界的操作，发现问题就发出警报，由我们分诊并升级进入事件处理流程。两层合在一起，构成了一套纵深防御的安全与对齐方案，我们认为这对打造安全的模型工厂至关重要。

blocks.text: 要让这一规模真正可行，需要对整个系统栈做改进。我们的 RL 基础设施部署了 NVFP4 MoE 训练与采样。采样时，prefill、draft 和 verify 全部运行在 CUDA graph 上。训练器沿用预训练栈，采用高专家并行、EPLB 和 CUDA graph 来提升 GPU 效率。为支撑长时程智能体负载，我们使用粘性路由和 DRAM KV 缓存卸载，将前缀缓存命中率维持在 93% 以上，从而在长上下文训练下仍能保持 5:3 的采样器与训练器比例。权重传输通过 GPUDirectRDMA 以 93% 以上的线速完成，并配有与并行度无关的校验和验证器。我们还提供了一种 NVFP4 KV 缓存变体，进一步降低部署推理成本，实测对评测结果的影响很小。

blocks.text: Inkling 2 Small was trained with RL on hundreds of thousands of long-horizon coding tasks across multiple agent harnesses and context-compaction strategies. We increased the quality of our synthetic coding data pipeline and moved beyond unit-test rewards alone; many tasks included an agentic RL grader that evaluated how the model approached the problem, not just whether its code passed. We also tested early checkpoints of Inkling 2 Small on OpenCode under the name Fledge-Alpha to assess our model’s performance on coding tasks in the real world.

Results for the Inkling models are averaged over 3 seeds; the other models use single runs. Costs are estimated by multiplying the number of sampling and training tokens with current tinker per-token pricing; for sampling, we assume prefix cache hits within rollouts among the same group.

blocks.text: On chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) risk, Inkling 2 Small’s knowledge and capability scores sit below the open-weight frontier. On FORTRESS, Scale AI’s private benchmark that scores how much harmful assistance a model gives in response to expert-written adversarial prompts across CBRN, terrorism, and nonviolent crime, Inkling 2 Small has a lower Average Risk Score compared with Inkling and Inkling-Small, and also demonstrates a higher Overrefusal Score (see Limitations). The helpful-only variant of Inkling 2 Small exhibits marginal uplift on CBRN knowledge relative to the release checkpoint, but it does not significantly advance the frontier on any dimension we measured.

blocks.text: As models take on unsupervised, longer-horizon autonomous work, the potential harm from their misbehavior increases. blocks.text: We worked across the stack to improve model alignment. In midtraining, we filtered out traces containing misbehavior and included traces with honest, aligned behavior. In RL, we added a general alignment reward that penalizes misbehavior on every task. We also built environments targeting specific failure modes we observed in training, such as rewarding models for giving up on impossible tasks. Finally, we used on-policy self-distillationZhao et al., 2026. from a teacher model prompted with a conduct spec, so the model internalizes principles for good behavior without explicit prompting.

blocks.text: We also worked to secure training and evaluations with two layers of monitoring. The first is synchronous: a monitor inspects tool calls before they run. Each task declares what actions it authorizes. Deterministic rules check calls against the task’s policy and circumvention patterns, escalating uncertain cases to an LLM judge. The second layer is asynchronous: an LLM judge reviews completed rollouts from training and evaluation for misbehavior and actions against our security boundary, raising alerts that we triage and escalate into our incident process. Together, these form a defense-in-depth approach to safety and alignment that we consider critical to developing a safe model factory.

blocks.text: Inkling 2 Small’s initial pretraining phase (H1) covered 8.4 trillion tokens of a broad mix of natural language, code, and image data. Training ran natively in NVFP4, the 4-bit floating-point format introduced with the NVIDIA Blackwell GPU architecture. We’ll share more details on our NVFP4 recipe in a follow-up post soon.

blocks.text: Making this scale practical required improvements throughout the systems stack. Our RL infrastructure deploys NVFP4 MoE training and sampling. During sampling, prefill, draft, and verify run fully on CUDA graphs. Trainers mirror the pretrain stack with high expert parallelism, EPLB, and CUDA graphs to improve GPU efficiency. To support long horizon agentic workloads, we use sticky routing and DRAM KV-cache offloading for maintaining 93%+ prefix cache hit rate, allowing us to maintain a 5:3 sampler:trainer ratio despite training at long contexts. Weight transfer is done via GPUDirectRDMA at 93%+ line rate with a parallelism-invariant checksum verifier. We also further lower deployment inference cost by offering a variant of NVFP4 KV cache, which we find to minimally lower evals.

Midway through the main RL run, our asynchronous monitor flagged an instance where the model, failing at a task, worked around a network block through a third-party service it could reach using its search tools. We paused the run, hardened our infrastructure, removed environments that required web access, and added synchronous tool-call monitoring. We then resumed the run, incorporating additional training phases specifically for alignment, as described above.
